predecessors.name: Eastern Zhou
predecessors.text: East Zhou, capital 'Gong (鞏), located just southwest of present-day Gongyi', Henan; the eastern-zhou dossier uses the same disc for its 314 split

successors.name: Qin (state)
successors.text: East Zhou, capital 'Gong (鞏), located just southwest of present-day Gongyi', Henan; the eastern-zhou dossier uses the same disc for its 314 split

ledger.x: 367: the Duchy of East Zhou breaks away from Western Zhou.
249: the state of East Zhou ends in Qin's annexation.

wars.name: Qin annexation of East Zhou
wars.outcome: Qin annexed East Zhou in 249 BC, 58 years after it became a Qin vassal (307) and seven years after the king of Zhou's submission in 256 (eastern-zhou dossier).

certainty.note: No East Zhou boundary is on the page; a county-sized duchy.
